s1.syndrome_frame: Acute gastrointestinal bleeding with epigastric pain and a submucosal gastric lesion
salient_findings: Epigastric pain
Hematemesis
Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration
Low hemoglobin level (6.3 g/dL) that improved with transfusion
Well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass with fat attenuation on CT
key_facts: One-week history of epigastric pain and hematemesis
No significant medical or surgical history
Hemoglobin rose to 10 g/dL after transfusion
Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration on endoscopy
Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT revealed a well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass

shortlist.label: Gastric lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal lesion with fat attenuation on CT

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration

shortlist.label: Leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal lesion with no malignant features on biopsy

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although biopsy showed no malignant features, cannot rule out rare malignant variants

shortlist.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although endoscopic biopsy revealed no malignant features, gastric cancer remains a consideration given the patient's symptoms

raw.rationale: The presence of a well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass with fat attenuation on contrast-enhanced abdominal CT, along with a submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum and no malignant features on biopsy, supports the diagnosis of a gastric lipoma.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
rejected.why: While possible, the presence of fat attenuation on CT is more suggestive of a lipoma than a GIST, which typically does not contain significant fat.

rejected.label: Leiomyoma
rejected.why: Leiomyomas are usually homogeneous and do not typically contain fat, making gastric lipoma a more likely diagnosis given the CT findings.

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: The absence of malignant features on biopsy and the specific imaging characteristics make leiomyosarcoma less likely.

rejected.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The biopsy showed no malignant features, and the imaging characteristics are not typical for gastric adenocarcinoma, which usually presents with more aggressive features on imaging and histology.
